content.short: Hacken is a blockchain security firm offering audits, offensive testing, monitoring, and compliance services for Web3 teams.
content.description: Hacken is a blockchain security and compliance company focused on helping Web3 projects secure code, infrastructure, and operations before and after launch. Its official site and docs emphasize smart contract audits, penetration testing, proof of reserves work, bug bounty programs, and ongoing security coverage backed by a large audit track record. Hacken also presents itself as a long running security partner for exchanges, protocols, enterprises, and public sector organizations, with support across many ecosystems including TON rather than a chain specific product.
